trial_court: Court of MS Neena Bansal Krishna, Principal District & Sessions Judge, South East: Saket Court, New Delhi
case_name: Sh. Hemant Chauhan S/O Sh. Rajpal Singh vs Ms. Meenu @ Anita W/O Sh. Hemant Chauhan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sh. Hemant Chauhan S/o Sh. Rajpal Singh (husband)
parties.respondent_defendant: Ms. Meenu @ Anita W/o Sh. Hemant Chauhan (wife)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Complainant filed complaint under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005. Appellant/husband allegedly gave severe beatings and made demands for Rs. 10 lacs or to leave the house. Complainant was forced to undergo abortion and was thrown out of shared household.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove the allegations made in the complaint.
legal_principles.held: Her own depositions prove that she was never the legally wedded wife of Appellant and therefore is not entitled to any relief under the Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A document's authenticity can be questioned if it is not corroborated by other evidence.
legal_principles.held: The entire case of the Complainant rests on her sole testimony which is not corroborated by any cogent document.

outcome.final_order: Monetary relief, compensation, protection and residence order under Section 12 of the Act in favour of the Respondent/Complainant were granted.

keywords: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
